summary: Procure 1Password Business contractor seats and enable SCIM provisioning for contractor offboarding
description:
Issue summary:
We need to purchase 1Password Business seats specifically for contractors (short-term and long-term) and set up SCIM provisioning so contractors are automatically deprovisioned when their access is revoked in our IdP. This is a procurement + identity onboarding ticket to avoid ad-hoc password sharing and reduce offboarding risk.

Background:
Currently contractors have been sharing generic credentials or asking full-time engineers to store secrets on their behalf. This pattern increases risk and makes rotation and audit difficult. Security has recommended moving contractors onto managed 1Password accounts with session/credential auditing and automated lifecycle via SCIM. Procurement has confirmed budget may be available from the engineering contractors cost center, but we need an official request and IT/Identity to configure the SCIM connector.

Impact:
- Improved security posture: unique credentials, rotation, and auditing for contractors.
- Reduced offboarding risk: automated deprovisioning when contractor access ends.
- Short-term engineering time to onboard contractors and update runbooks.

Request (what we need):
1) Purchase 30 1Password Business seats scoped for contractors (mix of short-term monthly and some annual as agreed with vendor).
2) Procurement to create reseller/contract with 1Password and confirm billing terms.
3) Identity team to enable SCIM/SCIM Gateway with our existing Okta tenant and set up a contractor group mapping.
4) Security review of 1Password configuration for team collections, admin roles, and auditing settings.
5) IT to document onboarding/offboarding runbook and add to internal runbook library.

Approvals / Cost center / Billing:
- Cost center: ENG-Contractors (please confirm cost center code).
- Estimated annual commitment: ~USD 8,000 - 12,000 depending on monthly vs annual seat mix (procurement to confirm final quote).
- Billing contact: finance-ops@redwood.com (confirm preferred billing contact).

Timeline / Desired cadence:
- Need procurement quote by 2026-03-18.
- SCIM connector test in staging by 2026-03-24.
- Production provisioning enabled and first 10 contractor accounts onboarded by 2026-03-31.

Technical notes / Steps to configure SCIM:
1) Procurement obtains 1Password Business admin account and license keys.
2) Identity team configures SCIM in Okta: create app integration, configure attribute mapping (email, displayName, contractor_tag), and limit SCIM to contractors group.
3) Enable SCIM Gateway if required by the vendor for API access, store credentials in a dedicated secrets collection in 1Password.
4) Run test provisioning with a staging contractor account; verify create/update/deactivate flows and audit logs.
5) Update onboarding runbook and notify hiring managers about the new contractor flow.

Security & Compliance considerations:
- Ensure MFA is enforced for all 1Password users.
- Ensure audit logs are forwarded or stored per retention policy; Security to confirm retention window meets compliance requirements.
- No secrets should be shared outside of approved 1Password collections.

Attachments / Links:
- Draft vendor quote request template: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/Procurement/Vendor+Quote+Template
- Existing contractor onboarding runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/IT/Contractor+Onboarding

Contact points:
- Reporter: Maya Patel (Security Program Manager)
- Identity lead: Evan Brooks (assigned)
- Procurement lead: Priya Singh (procurement@redwood.com)
- Finance billing: finance-ops@redwood.com
